question: In a certain code language, AGE is written as 13 and SEX is written as 48. How will COME be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

​AGE is written as 13

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1d8edfe34577b66684f02c85e81985c0464d29fa4b8e65025c1ba065f871d84.png] 

And,

SEX is written as 48

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2efb7b84d4b2851e6c0787ff52929c6d3dd1b687ea2867951216d7a04148c3cb.png] 

Similarly,

COME will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8fe6df820479be89d2145afd3a3c8aa416eb09feb9e2b28a2edc303267dfdfa.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
